sources: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (AI 100-1) subcategories; generative AI risks from the NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1).

checks.title: No accountable owner
checks.remediation: Name a business owner who is accountable for the system's use, risks, and outcomes.

checks.title: No impact assessment
checks.remediation: Assess who the system affects, how, and what could go wrong, and record the decision to deploy.

checks.title: Decisions about people made without human review
checks.remediation: Require a person to review and be able to override the AI output before it affects anyone.

checks.title: Not evaluated for harmful bias
checks.remediation: Test outcomes across relevant groups before use and periodically after; ask the vendor for its bias testing evidence.

checks.title: Not monitored in production
checks.remediation: Define what good performance looks like and review errors, complaints, and drift on a schedule.

checks.title: Vendor AI not reviewed
checks.remediation: Review the vendor's AI documentation, data handling, and security terms before and after deployment.

checks.title: Vendor may use your data to train its models
checks.remediation: Use an enterprise agreement or setting that prohibits training on your data, or keep personal data out of the tool.

checks.title: People are not told they are interacting with AI
checks.remediation: Tell customers and users when they are interacting with AI or receiving AI-generated content.

checks.title: Generative output reaches customers without review
checks.remediation: Limit the system to approved sources, add guardrails, and route sensitive or uncertain answers to a person.

checks.title: No AI incident process
checks.remediation: Define how AI errors and harms are reported, investigated, and communicated, and who can pause the system.

checks.title: Purpose and limits not documented
checks.remediation: Document the intended purpose, users, inputs, known limitations, and uses that are not allowed.
